questions.question_text: Molecular weights of Cimetidine, Ranitidine and Famotidine are 252, 314 and 273. Oral bioavailabilities and elimination half-life in man are almost similar. Which of these drugs could be more acceptable and why?

options.A: Cimetidine because of smaller molecular weight and potency
options.C: Famotidine because of lower dose and potency

questions.explanation: Famotidine has a significantly lower recommended clinical dose and higher potency compared to cimetidine and ranitidine.
